    Realization of finite pairs by strings #

    If the pair functor of finite half-words h = L (sign s) and h' = L' (sign !s) at v is nonzero on a module M, then the word L'⁻¹ L is a string (joinWord_isString): its signs alternate, and a chain family through a vector of num \ den shows that no walk spells a zero path. The pair is the pair of halves at position |L'| of this string.
